label: baseline
electricity_scope: Industrial byproduct supply is measured in kg H2/hour, with each interval limited by the selected conditioning capacity and the actual three-hour source availability. Conditioning and synthesis use grid electricity; no renewable power is assigned to industrial sources.
fixed_asset_scope: SAF and electrolyzer build/capacity; DAC build where present. Auxiliary inventory/transport use retains original optimization rules.
method: Feasible full-model dispatch with fixed candidate binaries and weekly routes; global lower bound from routing projection
